Riley Shaw: Kicking off onboarding for Pioneer Diagnostics. Internal prep only first - quick roll call and owners. Can we do a 20min dry run tomorrow 10:00am PT?
Priyanka Rao: +1. I'll own success criteria and the 30-day healthboard. Early thought: focus on telemetry, prompt quality, and a post-demo feedback capture.
Evan Li: I'll take the technical walkthrough (auth, webhooks, retries) and the perf checklist. Need to know expected ingestion for embeddings — ask the customer in pre-read.
Samantha Ortiz: I'll own enablement + developer quickstart. I'll prepare a 20min deck + 10min hands-on lab. Will include a tiny SDK snippet and a sample webhook consumer.
Riley Shaw: Stakeholders: Tom Becker (Pioneer PM) - primary; Lina Gomez (data) - integration lead; Julian Park (security). Internal owners: Riley (CS lead), Priyanka (CS Ops), Evan (SE), Samantha (Enablement).
Priyanka Rao: 30-day success criteria (compact): 1) Authenticated staging calls from Pioneer app; 2) 5 validated prompts with product-team sign-off; 3) Healthboard live with alerts and one alert test fired; 4) Pilot traffic >= 75 calls/day.
Evan Li: Proposed timeline: Day 0: creds + staging org; Day 1-5: schema mapping & integration; Day 6-12: validation + perf tuning; Day 13-26: pilot; Day 27-30: retro + handoff. If VPC/private requested add security review window (+5 business days).
Samantha Ortiz: Quick code snippet for the lab to show devs (will be in the deck):
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'model':'rwd-lite','prompt':'Extract findings'})
print(resp.json())
```
Riley Shaw: Renewal risk flags: mark "at-risk" if no pilot traffic by day 30 OR if security prevents necessary data flow. Priyanka please add a renewal_flag column to the board with mitigation playbooks.
Priyanka Rao: Will do. Also planning a 3-question post-demo survey: integration ease (1-5), prompt quality (1-5), blockers (free text). I'll wire the form and capture responses after demo.
ops-bot: Scheduled "Pioneer Dx  Internal Dry Run" for 2026-06-08 10:00 PT. Guests: Riley Shaw, Priyanka Rao, Evan Li, Samantha Ortiz.
Evan Li: Action items: Evan - perf checklist + infra notes; Samantha - deck + quickstart + lab; Priyanka - healthboard + survey; Riley - customer invite + agenda + pre-read asking expected QPS and embedding volumes.
Riley Shaw: If there are no objections I'll run the dry run and then invite Tom/Lina/Julian after rehearsal. :thumbsup: Closing thread until rehearsal notes posted.
